hook.name: AtlasHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that functions as an on-chain DEX aggregator, routing swaps across up to 12 hardcoded V3/V4 pools embedded in its bytecode using a price-sorted RFQ mechanism, and collecting a service fee on each swap via donate. Pool initialization and liquidity additions are restricted to a single admin address checked via tx.origin.
